title: Microsoft Teams: send chat messages while a file uploads in the background
summary: The briefing passes: its default state, licensing context and rollout targets are supported, and no switch specific to background uploads was found. One sentence needs a minor correction: Microsoft's notice schedules the Targeted Release start but does not confirm that rollout actually began.
